svg.title: Allo g spacing: Black guard pairs distinguish targeted spacing from blanket tightening

g.aria-label: Black / 900 · Same amounts, different scope · A: 0 units; B: 64 units; C: 128 units tighter
ROUND FOLLOWERS ONLY / go, ge, gc
All-followers C produces actual outline overlaps in: gy, gj. Round mode leaves these pairs unchanged.
All-followers B leaves gj about 8.4 units of sampled horizontal clearance. No overlap does not guarantee good spacing.
